intro.body:
Your agent learns the patterns.
You direct the application.
The code stays yours to follow.

panel.title: A panel changes. The page stays put.
panel.body: A Region gives a changing part of the page one owner. Show a new View there, and Marionette destroys the old one.
points: The replaced View gets a clean exit.

panelAgain.title: A new answer. The same place.
panelAgain.body: That was another View replacement. The heading, controls and code pane stayed where they were. Give the changing part a home and leave the rest alone.
